Filtronic
UK  |  RF & Microwave Components
Market Expansion
Filtronic has signed a non-binding MOU with Marubeni Group subsidiary Spur Microwave Inc to accelerate its expansion into India's space and defence sector, gaining a route to market with government, space and defence customers.
🔗 Source: Filtronic
👤 LinkedIn Post
Filtronic is opening a new front line in one of the world's fastest-growing space markets. The RF and microwave specialist has signed a non-binding MOU with Spur Microwave, part of Japan's Marubeni Group, to accelerate its expansion into India's space and defence sector. Spur becomes Filtronic's route to market there - helping it engage government, space and defence customers with the scale and credibility of a major trading group behind it. Strategic distribution deals like this are how UK space supply chain companies turn a strong domestic order book into a genuinely global one. Proud to have Filtronic exhibiting at Space-Comm Expo Europe 2027. ESA Industry Forum
Europe  |  Government / Space Agency
Industry News
ESA's High-Level Forum with Industry in Paris (3 September) set out how the record €22.1bn Member States committed at the CM25 Ministerial will convert into real contracts across Earth observation, telecoms, navigation, science and the new European Resilience from Space initiative.
🔗 Source: ESA
👤 LinkedIn Post
Europe just got clearer on how last year's record space budget turns into actual contracts. At ESA's High-Level Forum with Industry in Paris on 3 September, senior figures from across the sector - large primes, midcaps, SMEs and young space companies - set out how the €22.1bn Member States committed at the CM25 Ministerial will convert into real programmes across Earth observation, telecoms, navigation, science and the new European Resilience from Space initiative. The ask from industry was consistent: more stability, faster decisions, simpler processes. This is exactly the kind of procurement translation moment commercial space companies need to be in the room for - which is exactly what Space-Comm Expo Europe exists to deliver. NATO Space Investment
Europe / North America  |  Government / Defence
Industry News
NCIA General Manager Dr Dylan Browne says roughly a quarter of the agency's budget already covers space - secure communications, commercial satellite services and imagery - as European Allies raised core defence investment nearly 20% and unlocked over $50bn in new procurement, with a clear push to work more closely with industry.
🔗 Source: Via Satellite
👤 LinkedIn Post
NATO is putting real money behind space - and it wants commercial industry in the room. NCIA General Manager Dr Dylan Browne says roughly a quarter of the agency's budget already goes on space, spanning secure communications, commercial satellite services and imagery, as European Allies lifted core defence investment by nearly 20% last year and unlocked over $50bn in new procurement at the recent Summit - with a clear steer towards working more closely with industry. For commercial space companies without an existing foot in defence procurement, this is precisely the kind of institutional shift worth watching - and being ready for.
